# `AutoOpenCamera`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Guider notification that the guide camera was reopened automatically.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (shape only; observation for the receiver) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, Camera_ZWO::ScanZWOCams @0xfcde0 (64-bit guider build); 32-bit counterpart unresolved |

Custom emitter. Sent when the guider's ZWO camera scan reopens the guide camera after an automatic reconnect succeeds. No state, code or error members. Sent by the guider (zwoair_guider) event server on TCP 4400 to every retained connection, with no verified or master/guest filter. The main imager process, which holds a client connection to 4400, recognizes peer event lines by the exact substring "Event":" and re-broadcasts the original line unchanged to all retained connections on TCP 4700, so ordinary 4700 clients see it too; the auxiliary imager process (4702) deliberately does not forward 4400 events, avoiding a duplicate copy. Because the forwarding test is lexical, the forwarded line is byte-identical to the guider's. No universal order relative to RPC replies or other events, no sequence number, no replay. The imager installs a local AutoOpenCamera callback; that does not establish a different wire shape. Related method data: guider camera connection status. No name-specific 32-bit emitter attribution is established; do not assume the 32-bit build sends it.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"AutoOpenCamera"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string <seconds>.<nine digits> from clock id 1 (monotonic, INFERRED); not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `device` | string | yes | - | Guider camera identifier. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, reopened - Guide camera reopened (READ shape, values invented):

```json
{"Event":"AutoOpenCamera","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","device":"Example guide camera"}
```
